args.description: A modular pixel-art ability button sheet on a transparent 192x128 canvas. TOP: one broad horizontal SILVER button frame about 176 pixels wide and 62 pixels tall, centered at x96,y38, contained within x8..183,y7..69. Dark purple-black quiet center RESERVED EMPTY for a separate dynamic character symbol. Top-center and bottom-center tiny gold diamonds; very small gold side ornaments. Restrained low-contrast purple curl flourish at each inner far side only, leave center x66..125 quiet. BOTTOM CENTER: a separate small crowned ivory skeleton skull emblem, around 32x36 pixels, centered at x96,y102, fully detached from the frame with clear transparent margin. Simple whimsical skull, two black sockets, small gold crown with three points; no body, no character portrait. The emblem must be removable so other character symbols can use the same frame. Native pixel-art fantasy game UI, front-facing orthographic. Closely match the supplied approved A wave/settings family: broad polished SILVER bevels, dark clean outline, 45-degree chamfer corners, bright top/left and restrained lower/right planes, 85 percent silver trim with only 15 percent tiny warm gold jewelry. No bolts, rivets, stone cracks, gritty texture, blurry gradients, antialiasing, random sparkles, text or numbers. Leave several clear transparent pixels around every sprite. Keep the depicted components at their requested small native size within the canvas; don't enlarge them to fill the sheet.
